description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Monastery Flock, adding {U}.
When Monastery Flock dies, Yedora triggers, returning Monastery Flock from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Monastery Flock by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Monastery Flock's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
